protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

source.description: AI-assisted translation of all 27 paragraphs of the original benchmark article. Codex checked the paragraph sequence, recurring names, plot details, numeric values and Supertonic frontend coverage. No independent human translation review.

support.scope: Pinned calibrated Dutch model and official Dutch browser frontend only. One bundled Alex voice (index 0), nl-NL, 24 kHz. Eligible fixture: nl-article-v1.
support.notes: Experimental Dutch profile. Base model card reports 4,537,291 parameters; this is a lower bound because 4,053 calibrated-excitation values are also present and the graph has extra initializers. Publisher browser worker pins one-thread WASM, voice alex, speed 1, pitch 0/range 1, at most 256 tokens, 3,000 frames, recursive clause/word splits, per-utterance 0.99 peak cap and no inserted audio gaps. Calibrated excitation is stochastic and has no synthesis seed. The nl-article-v1 translation has no independent human review.
